Menu.Name: Krynn
Menu.Label: Open the Krynn settings
Menu.Hint: The age and date of the campaign, the calendar, the moons of magic and the gods.

UserCulture.Name: Calendar names
UserCulture.Hint: Whose names you see for the months and the days of the week.
UserCulture.World: My character's people, or the world's default

ShowBanner.Name: Show the sky banner
ShowBanner.Hint: A strip at the top of the screen with the date, the period and the moons.

Date.Hint: The year decides which gods answer, whether the moons of magic shine, and which orders and armies stand.
Date.YearHint: Years after the Cataclysm are positive (351 is 351 AC); years before it are negative (-1018 is 1018 PC).

Calendar.CultureHint: Each player can choose their own in the module's settings (Calendar names).
Calendar.EyeHint: The date of one night when all three moons were full together. Every phase follows from it; the Eye returns every 504 days.

MoonMagic.Label: Moon magic
MoonMagic.Hint: How strongly the moons change High Sorcery for characters with the feat Mage of High Sorcery (compendium Krynn: Magic). Applied as an effect on their sheet, each day.
MoonMagic.classic: Classic: bonuses and penalties by phase, alignments, the Night of the Eye
MoonMagic.light: Light: a bonus at High Sanction only
MoonMagic.narrative: Narrative: chat and sheet notes, no numbers

Gods.Label: When the gods are absent
Gods.Hint: What happens to the divine spells of a caster with a god in years the gods do not answer (before 351 AC, and from 384 to 420 AC). Mystics of the Heart are not affected.
Gods.strict: Strict: divine spells of an absent god fail
Gods.warn: Warn: they work, and the GM is told

Nuitari.Label: Who sees Nuitari
Nuitari.blackRobes: The GM and the Black Robes

Announce.Label: Announce the sky in chat
Announce.Hint: Post a card when a moon reaches High Sanction, on the Night of the Eye, on holy days and when the age changes.

Life.Hint: Every life a player lives in Foundry leads to this campaign. Players don't choose these; you do.
Life.Summary: Lives will lead to {year} AC, in {region}.
Life.Clamped: Lifewrought covers 1–430 AC, so the year was brought into that range.
Life.StartHint: Leave empty and the dice choose a town in the region
Life.NpcActors: The people of each life as NPCs
Life.NpcActorsHint: Besides the Chronicle journal, create an NPC actor for each person met in the life (family, mentors, rivals, loves).
Life.KrynnHeritagesHint: Kender, the elven nations, the Neidar and the clans of Thorbardin, and tinker gnomes get the heritage of the Krynn: Peoples compendium instead of a PF2e one.

HighSorcery.Label: When the moons are gone
HighSorcery.Hint: What happens to the arcane spells of mages of High Sorcery from 384 to 420 AC. Primal Sorcerers are not affected.
HighSorcery.warn: Warn: they work, and the GM is told

MoonMinLevel.Label: Moons matter from level
MoonMinLevel.Hint: The older rules left apprentices (levels 1 to 3) untouched by the moons. 1 means always.

Throes.Label: Draconians' death throes
Throes.Hint: What happens when a draconian drops to 0 Hit Points.
Throes.auto: Automatic: the card, the token changes, the acid pool on the map
Throes.card: Card only: the chat card with its damage and saves

Dragons.FearCardsHint: Post a card with the Will save for the enemies within each dragon's Dragonfear when combat starts.

Style.classic: Classic: twelve months of thirty days (360 days)
Style.kalaman: Kalaman: twelve months of four weeks (336 days)

before.Name: Before the Cataclysm
before.Text: The gods walk with their priests; Istar rises, and falls.

despair.Name: The years of despair
despair.Text: The gods are silent; false priests, hard years, and armies gathering in the east.

war.Name: The War of the Lance
war.Text: The dragonarmies march, the true gods return, and the Heroes of the Lance rise.

after.Name: After the war
after.Text: The gods have returned and the Knights are reborn; new orders grow in the dark.

chaos.Name: The Chaos War
chaos.Text: The Summer of Chaos: the Father of All and of Nothing breaks free.

mortals.Name: The Age of Mortals
mortals.Text: The gods and the moons of magic are gone; the great dragons rule, and mortals find magic of their own.

souls.Name: After the War of Souls
souls.Text: The gods have returned, and the moons of magic shine again.

Sky.Title: The sky of Krynn
Sky.MoonsAbsent: The moons of magic are gone
Sky.EyeTonight: Tonight is the Night of the Eye: the three moons stand together, full.
Sky.NuitariHidden: Only the Black Robes see the black moon.
Sky.EyeIn: The next Night of the Eye is in {days} days ({date}).
Sky.PaleMoon: A single pale moon crosses the sky. The moons of magic are gone.

yearDay.Name: Year Day
yearDay.Text: The first day of the year: gifts, and promises renewed.

darkDay.Name: Dark Day
darkDay.Text: The anniversary of the Cataclysm, kept in black and in silence.

harnkeggerfest.Name: Harnkeggerfest
harnkeggerfest.Text: Five days of the hill dwarves, opening the first keg of summer ale.

kithKanandras.Name: Kith-Kanandras
kithKanandras.Text: Honouring Kith-Kanan and the founding of Qualinesti; all peoples welcome.

silvanosdras.Name: Silvanosdras
silvanosdras.Text: The elves keep the birthday of Silvanos, who united the first elven tribes.

springDawning.Name: Spring Dawning
springDawning.Text: The spring equinox: the festival of Solace, and the Knights' contests of arms.

harrowing.Name: Harrowing
harrowing.Text: The planting season begins across Ansalon.

midyearDay.Name: Midyear Day
midyearDay.Text: The longest day: lights and dancing, and in Thorbardin the forges relit.

festivalOfCandles.Name: Festival of Candles
festivalOfCandles.Text: The dwarves remember their dead with floating lanterns.

summersEnd.Name: Summer's End
summersEnd.Text: The autumn equinox, and the start of the harvest.

festivalOfKnights.Name: Festival of Knights
festivalOfKnights.Text: A day for the Knights of Solamnia.

genealogyDay.Name: Genealogy Day
genealogyDay.Text: Gnomes file corrections to their names with the Genealogy Guild.

thanksALotDay.Name: Thanks-a-Lot Day
thanksALotDay.Text: Kender give thanks for everything that fell into their pockets this year.

yule.Name: Yule
yule.Text: The winter solstice: the Yule log is lit, and families gather before the snows.

Chat.Speaker: Krynn
Chat.Eye: The Night of the Eye: Solinari, Lunitari and Nuitari stand together, full.
Chat.High: {moon} reaches High Sanction, the strength of {robe} ({date}).

age.might: The Age of Might begins: the time of Istar.
age.despair: The Age of Despair: the Cataclysm has fallen.

period.war: The War of the Lance has begun.
period.mortals: The Age of Mortals: the great dragons come.
period.souls: The War of Souls is over.

gods.return: The true gods answer prayers again: divine magic returns.
gods.leave: The gods are gone from Krynn: divine magic is silent.

moons.return: The moons of magic shine again: High Sorcery returns.
moons.leave: The moons of magic have vanished: a single pale moon rises, and High Sorcery fails.

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Krynn
Welcome.Text: The calendar is now the Calendar of Krynn, set to {date}. Change the age, date, moons and gods in Settings → Krynn.

SelfTest.Hint: Checks that the module is set up in this Foundry and PF2e, and posts the result to the GM in chat.

Check.Calendar: The Krynn calendar is the world calendar
Check.CalendarAgrees: Foundry's date and Krynn's date agree
Check.Names: Month and day names for every culture
Check.Moons: The three moons and the Night of the Eye
Check.Languages: The languages of Krynn are registered
Check.Traits: The creature traits of Krynn are registered
Check.LifeBuild: A random life builds from this world's PF2e compendiums
Check.Packs: The compendiums of Krynn (magic, gods, peoples, backgrounds, orders, tables, creatures, dragons, relics, iconic people, atlas, guides)
Check.CastGate: Spells check the gods and the moons when cast
Check.MoonMagic: Tonight's moon magic for the three Orders
Check.LifePage: The Lifewrought page finds its files
Check.Dragons: Legacy dragons for the Dragons of Krynn window
Check.Enrichers: The Atlas's live lines and Timeline years

TraitText.kender: Small, fearless and endlessly curious folk of Krynn, related to halflings.
TraitText.draconian: Dragonmen bred from corrupted dragon eggs; each kind dies in its own way.
TraitText.aghar: The gully dwarves: the lowest of dwarvenkind, survivors of everything.
TraitText.irda: The high ogres of the far south, beautiful and secretive shapechangers.
TraitText.highSorcery: Tied to the Orders of High Sorcery and the moons of magic.
TraitText.solamnicKnight: Tied to the Oath and the Measure of the Knights of Solamnia.
TraitText.mystic: Magic of the heart, drawn from within rather than from a god.
TraitText.darkKnight: Belongs to the Knights of Takhisis (later of Neraka), the dark order sworn to the Vision of the Queen of Darkness.

Life.Title: Live a life on Krynn
Life.NoEngine: The Lifewrought engine did not load (lifewrought/engine.js).
Life.NoData: The Lifewrought tables did not load ({status}).
Life.NeedGM: Only a GM can create the character.
Life.NotFinished: This life is not finished yet.
Life.Created: {name} is ready: the character is in the Actors, and their Chronicle in the Journal.
Life.Failed: The character could not be created: {error}
Life.Queued: No GM is online. The life is saved; the character will be created when a GM connects.
Life.Timeout: The GM did not answer. Try again, or ask the GM to build it from the Lives window.
Life.Missing: {n} items were not found in this world's compendiums and were left out:
Life.ExtraDraws: The saved life ended {n} rolls early; those rolls were made again.

Page.ThreadsHint: What this life leaves for the story: secrets, enemies, debts and reasons to adventure. The player lived it; this page is for your notes.

Life.ArcaneText: On Krynn every arcane caster belongs to an order of High Sorcery or is a renegade. Add {link} to the character and choose the robes, and the moons will start to count.

Feat.MoonwiseToggle: Moonwise: about the moons or the Orders

Magic.Bonus: +{value} status bonus to spell attack rolls and spell DCs.
Magic.Penalty: −{value} status penalty to spell attack rolls and spell DCs.

Note.high: High Sanction: your moon is full. Once today you may regain one expended spell slot of a rank no higher than half your level rounded down, minus 1 (minimum 1), if you have Lunar Reservoir.
Note.waxing: Waxing: your moon grows; your magic is steady and rising.
Note.waning: Waning: your moon shrinks; your magic is steady.
Note.low: Low Sanction: your moon is dark; spells come hard.
Note.aligned: Your moon stands in alignment with another: +1.
Note.eye: The Night of the Eye: the three moons stand together, full. The Orders' great rituals can be worked tonight.

Magic.BlockedGods: {who} prays for {spell}, and no god answers. The spell fails; nothing is spent.
Magic.BlockedMoons: {who} reaches for {spell}, but the moons of magic are gone. The spell fails; nothing is spent.
Magic.WarnGods: {who} cast {spell}, a divine spell, in {year}, when the gods are absent.
Magic.WarnMoons: {who} cast {spell} through High Sorcery in {year}, when the moons are gone.

Factions.Title: Factions
Factions.Hint: Standing uses PF2e's attitudes. The GM changes it as the story goes; the player sees it here.

Finish.Title: {name}: choices to make
Finish.Text: PF2e still needs a few choices for {items}. Open the character sheet and press Finish choices: PF2e will ask for them.
Finish.NotOwner: Only the character's owner can finish its choices.
Finish.NoSource: {name} could not be found in its compendium; take it again by hand.

Throes.Title: {name}: death throes
Throes.SivakShape: The body takes the shape of {who}, the one who killed it.
Throes.Pool: In the pool (it dries up after {rounds} rounds):
Throes.Frenzy: It fights on for {rounds} rounds (Final Frenzy), then explodes.

Dragons.Title: Dragons of Krynn
Dragons.Hint: The chromatic and metallic dragons of your legacy bestiaries, brought into this world with the Krynn templates: Dragonfear, and for the Overlords the elite adjustment, Gargantuan size and the Skull Totem.
Dragons.None: No legacy dragons found. Enable the legacy bestiary in this world.
Dragons.NeedGM: Only a GM can bring dragons in.
Dragons.Imported: {name} is in the Actors, in Dragons of Krynn.
Dragons.FearText: Every enemy within {feet} feet attempts the Will save:

Atlas.GoTitle: Bring the world to this year?
Atlas.GoText: Set the world's date to the first day of {year} ({what})? The age, the gods and the moons follow.

baaz-draconian.Notes: The most common of the draconians: soldiers bred for numbers, loud and quick to anger. Born from corrupted brass dragon eggs.
baaz-draconian.glide: The draconian's stubby wings can't lift it, but it takes no damage from a fall and can move 5 feet sideways for every 10 feet it falls.
baaz-draconian.brute-rush: The baaz Strides twice and makes a longsword Strike. If it hits, the target is pushed 5 feet.

kapak-draconian.Notes: Scouts, assassins and saboteurs of the dragonarmies, with venom in their mouths. Born from copper dragon eggs.
kapak-draconian.sneak-attack: The kapak deals 1d6 extra precision damage to off-guard creatures.
kapak-draconian.toxic-saliva: The kapak licks its blade. Its next Strike that hits before the end of its turn exposes the target to kapak venom.<hr />@Localize[KRYNN.Bestiary.Venom.kapak]

bozak-draconian.Notes: Sorcerers and sergeants, the bozaks lead the lesser draconians with magic and fear. Born from bronze dragon eggs.
bozak-draconian.sorcerous-blast: A 15-foot cone of red fire: @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:18|basic].
bozak-draconian.web-of-shadows:
Frequency once per hour
Sticky threads fill a 10-foot burst within 60 feet. Each creature there must attempt @Check[reflex|dc:18]. Failure immobilized for 1 round or until it Escapes. Critical Failure also restrained until it Escapes.
bozak-draconian.commander: One baaz or kapak within 30 feet that can hear the bozak gains a +1 status bonus to its next attack roll this round.

sivak-draconian.Notes: Big, winged and cunning, the sivaks are the dragonarmies' hunters and infiltrators. Born from silver dragon eggs.
sivak-draconian.take-the-face:
Requirements The sivak killed a humanoid of size Small to Large within the last minute.
It takes that creature's exact shape and voice, as the polymorph trait describes, until it chooses to end it. It gains a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to pass as that creature.
sivak-draconian.sky-strike: The sivak Flies up to its fly Speed and makes a greatsword Strike at the end. On a hit, the target is knocked prone.

aurak-draconian.Notes: Wingless, golden and the most dangerous of the draconians: sorcerers who command the others. Born from gold dragon eggs.
aurak-draconian.lightning-rays: Two rays at one or two targets within 60 feet; make a spell attack roll (+22) for each. Each hit deals @Damage[3d8[electricity]] damage.
aurak-draconian.golden-veil:
Frequency once per hour
The aurak becomes invisible for 1 minute, or until it uses a hostile action.
aurak-draconian.dimension-step:
Frequency once per 10 minutes
The aurak teleports to a place it can see within 60 feet.
aurak-draconian.borrowed-face: The aurak looks like any humanoid of its size, an illusion that a creature who Seeks and succeeds at @Check[perception|dc:23] sees through.

bakali-warrior.Notes: The great lizard-folk of the old southern swamps, proud, territorial and slow to trust anyone warm-blooded.
bakali-warrior.bellow:
Frequency once per minute
Each enemy within 30 feet attempts @Check[will|dc:14]; on a failure it is frightened 1.

thanoi-hunter.Notes: Walrus-folk of the frozen Icereach, who hunt on the ice floes and raid the ice folk's camps.
thanoi-hunter.ice-adapted: The thanoi ignores difficult terrain from ice and snow and isn't harmed by severe cold.
thanoi-hunter.tusk-rake: The thanoi makes a tusks Strike. On a hit, the target takes @Damage[1d6[bleed]] persistent bleed damage.

aghar-scrounger.Notes: Gully dwarves: the outcast clan, who live on what others throw away and outlast everyone who looks down on them.
aghar-scrounger.survivor: The aghar gains a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons from spoiled food and foul water.
aghar-scrounger.duck-and-cover:
Trigger A creature targets the aghar with a Strike.
The aghar drops prone, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering Strike.

kyrie-skywatcher.Notes: Bird-folk of the far southern isles, wary of outsiders and of the land-bound wars of Ansalon.
kyrie-skywatcher.dive: The kyrie Flies at least 20 feet downward and makes a talons Strike; on a hit it deals 1d8 extra damage.

spectral-minion.Notes: Spirits held to a broken vow: soldiers still guarding a fallen gate, servants still waiting on a dead lord.
spectral-minion.unfinished-oath: The minion is bound to the task it failed in life. When the task is finished or released, it is laid to rest. Until then, if destroyed, it re-forms in 1d4 days near where it fell.

dreamwraith.Notes: Shapes from a nightmare made real: twisted soldiers, weeping trees and hungry beasts, real enough to kill.
dreamwraith.made-of-dreams: A creature that spends an action to disbelieve the dreamwraith attempts @Check[will|dc:21]. On a success, it takes half damage from the dreamwraith for the rest of the encounter.
dreamwraith.dread-whisper: One creature within 30 feet attempts @Check[will|dc:21]. Failure frightened 2. Critical Failure frightened 2 and fleeing for 1 round.

fireshadow.Notes: A living shadow of flame that haunts burned places and the fires of sorcerers who called more than they could hold.
fireshadow.flicker: The fireshadow vanishes into a flame or light source and steps out of another within 60 feet.
fireshadow.ember-burst:
Frequency once per minute
A 10-foot emanation of sparks: @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:19|basic].

irda-wanderer.Notes: The high ogres, beautiful and secretive, who hid from the world and walk it now and then under borrowed faces.
irda-wanderer.many-faces: The irda takes the shape of any Medium humanoid until it chooses to change back. Creatures who Seek with @Check[perception|dc:19] notice something is off.
irda-wanderer.starlight-ward:
Frequency once per hour; Trigger The irda would be hit by a Strike.
The irda gains a +2 status bonus to AC against the triggering Strike.

Throes.baaz: When the baaz dies, it turns to stone. The creature that struck the killing blow with a melee weapon attempts a Reflex save against the baaz's DC; on a failure, the weapon is stuck in the stone until the statue crumbles to dust at the start of the baaz's next turn (or the wielder succeeds at an Athletics check to Force Open against the same DC).
Throes.kapak: When the kapak dies, its body melts into a pool of acid 10 feet across. A creature in the pool when it forms, or that ends its turn in it, takes acid damage (basic Reflex save against the kapak's DC). The pool dries up after 3 rounds.
Throes.bozak: When the bozak dies, its flesh shrivels away and its bones burst outward. Each creature within 10 feet takes piercing damage (basic Reflex save against the bozak's DC).
Throes.sivak: When a humanoid kills the sivak, the body takes the killer's shape for three days, a body that looks like the killer's own. If anything else kills it, the sivak bursts into flame: each creature adjacent takes fire damage (basic Reflex save against the sivak's DC).
Throes.aurak: When the aurak drops to 0 Hit Points, it doesn't die yet. Wrapped in green fire, it goes into a frenzy for 2 rounds: it can't be reduced further, gains a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and acts only to attack. Then it explodes: each creature within 10 feet takes electricity damage (basic Reflex save against the aurak's DC).

Venom.kapak: Kapak Venom (poison) Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude; Maximum Duration 4 rounds; Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] and clumsy 1 (1 round); Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] and slowed 1 (1 round); Stage 3 paralyzed (1 round).

tanis-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

A reluctant leader, at home neither with elves nor humans, who holds the companions together because no one else will.
tanis-351.rally:
Frequency once per round
One ally within 30 feet gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its next attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn.

raistlin-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

A young Red Robe of brilliant, bitter power, who passed the Test at a price no one else knows in full. His brother is never far.
raistlin-351.force-bolts: Two darts of force strike creatures he can see within 120 feet; each deals @Damage[1d4+1[force]] damage, no roll needed.
raistlin-351.sleep-mist:
Frequency once per hour
A 5-foot burst within 30 feet. Each creature attempts @Check[will|dc:18]; on a failure it falls unconscious for 1 minute or until hurt or shaken awake.
raistlin-351.frail: After his Test, Raistlin's body is weak and his eyes see everything wither. On a critical failure on a Fortitude save, he also falls into a coughing fit: stunned 1.

caramon-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

Big, warm-hearted and stronger than anyone in the room, he has lived for his twin since they were children.
caramon-351.brothers-shield:
Trigger An enemy adjacent to Caramon attacks Raistlin.
Caramon makes a Strike against it before the attack is rolled.

sturm-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

A Knight without a knighthood, keeping the Measure in a land that spits on it, with his father's sword and armour.
sturm-351.oath-and-measure: Sturm gains a +2 status bonus to saving throws against fear, and never retreats while an ally is in danger.

tasslehoff-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

Endlessly curious, endlessly cheerful, and owner of an enormous collection of things that other people have dropped.
tasslehoff-351.kender-taunt: One creature within 30 feet attempts @Check[will|dc:17]; on a failure it is off-guard against Tas's allies until the end of its next turn.

flint-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

A hill dwarf smith who grumbles about everything and would die for any of them. He hates boats, and horses, and elves' cooking.
flint-351.grumble: Flint gains a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against poison and against being knocked prone.

goldmoon-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

Chieftain's daughter of the Que-Shu, bearer of the Blue Crystal Staff, and the first true cleric of the gods in three hundred years.
goldmoon-351.mishakals-touch:
Frequency three times per day
A creature she touches regains @Damage[3d8+8[healing]] Hit Points.
goldmoon-351.staff-refuses:
Trigger An unholy creature touches or strikes with the Blue Crystal Staff.
It takes @Damage[4d6[spirit]] damage and lets go.

riverwind-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

A Que-Shu hunter of a low-born family, who went on an impossible quest to marry the chieftain's daughter and came back with a staff.
riverwind-351.hunters-mark: Riverwind marks one creature he can see. His Strikes against it deal 1d8 extra damage until he marks another.

tika-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

The barmaid of the Inn of the Last Home, brave, red-haired and still learning which end of a sword to hold.
tika-351.barroom-brawler: Tika Shoves or Trips an adjacent creature, and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the check if it is taller than she is.

laurana-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

The Speaker's daughter, who has loved Tanis since they were young and has just decided to stop waiting for him at home.
laurana-351.princess: Laurana gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy with elves of Qualinesti.

gilthanas-351.Notes:
Autumn 351 AC, the Inn of the Last Home

Laurana's brother, a prince of Qualinesti, a mage and a warrior, and suspicious of the half-elf his sister loves.
gilthanas-351.elven-spell: A ray of fire at one target within 60 feet: spell attack +16, @Damage[2d6+4[fire]] damage.

laurana-golden-general.Notes:
352 AC, the Whitestone armies

She took command when the Knights had none, and the armies follow her hair, gold under the sun, into every battle.
laurana-golden-general.golden-general:
Frequency once per round
Allies within 60 feet who can see her gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and to saves against fear until the start of her next turn.
laurana-golden-general.dragonrider: Mounted on a dragon, Laurana's dragonlance deals 3d8 extra spirit damage to dragons.

raistlin-358.Notes:
358 AC, Master of Past and Present

Now in black robes, master of the Tower of Palanthas, and set on a goal no mage has dared: the Dark Queen's own throne.
raistlin-358.meteor-fall:
Frequency once per hour
Four 20-foot bursts within 500 feet: @Damage[19d6[fire]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:36|basic].
raistlin-358.black-bolt: One creature within 120 feet: spell attack +37, @Damage[8d10[void]] damage.
raistlin-358.time-walker:
Frequency once per hour; Trigger Raistlin would be hit by an attack.
He steps a moment out of time: the attack misses, and he teleports up to 30 feet.

caramon-358.Notes:
358 AC, after Istar

He followed his brother into the past and came back knowing he must let him go.
caramon-358.gladiator: Caramon makes two Strikes against the same target; both count as one for his multiple attack penalty.

goldmoon-citadel.Notes:
Age of Mortals, the Citadel of Light

With the gods gone, she found the power in the heart, and founded the Citadel of Light to teach it to anyone.
goldmoon-citadel.power-of-the-heart:
Frequency three times per day
Mysticism, not a god's gift: up to three creatures within 30 feet each regain @Damage[6d8+20[healing]] Hit Points.

kitiara-352.Notes:
352 AC, Highlord of the Blue Dragonarmy

The twins' half-sister, a sword for hire turned Highlord, who rides the blue dragon Skie and wants everything.
kitiara-352.dragon-highlord: One ally within 60 feet can immediately Step or make a Strike as a reaction.
kitiara-352.riposte:
Trigger A creature critically fails a Strike against Kitiara.
She makes a Strike against it.

lord-soth.Notes:
The Knight of the Black Rose

A Knight of Solamnia who failed at the moment that mattered, cursed to an undying life in Dargaard Keep with the warriors who died with him.
lord-soth.death-word:
Frequency once per day
One living creature within 30 feet of 15th level or lower attempts @Check[fortitude|dc:38]. Failure It dies. Success @Damage[10d10[void]] damage.
lord-soth.dread-presence: 60 feet. A creature that enters attempts @Check[will|dc:38]; on a failure it is frightened 2, on a critical failure also fleeing for 1 round.
lord-soth.hellfire:
Frequency once per hour
A 20-foot burst within 120 feet: @Damage[20d6[fire]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:38|basic].

verminaard.Notes:
351 AC, Highlord of the Red Dragonarmy

A cleric of the Dark Queen in a horned helmet, who rules Abanasinia from Pax Tharkas on the red dragon Ember.
verminaard.nightbringer:
Frequency once per round
After a hit with his mace, the target attempts @Check[fortitude|dc:23]; on a failure it is blinded for 1 round.
verminaard.takhisis-favour:
Frequency twice per day
He regains @Damage[4d8+16[healing]] Hit Points.

ariakas.Notes:
352 AC, Emperor of the Dragon Empire

The Dark Queen's general and emperor, as strong as he is cruel, ruling the Highlords by fear.
ariakas.crown-of-power: While he wears the Crown, Ariakas gains a +2 status bonus to saving throws, and whoever holds the Crown commands the dragonarmies.

toede.Notes:
351 AC, Fewmaster of Solace

A hobgoblin officer of the dragonarmies, vain, greedy and very good at surviving.
toede.cowards-command:
Trigger An enemy moves adjacent to Toede.
An ally within 30 feet Strides toward the enemy, and Toede Steps away.

fistandantilus.Notes:
Before the Cataclysm

The greatest of the Black Robes, who lengthens his life by taking the lives of his apprentices.
fistandantilus.life-drain: One creature within 30 feet attempts @Check[fortitude|dc:39]: @Damage[12d8[void]] damage (basic), and Fistandantilus regains half as Hit Points.
fistandantilus.archmage-storm:
Frequency once per hour
A 30-foot burst within 500 feet: @Damage[21d6[electricity]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:39|basic].

dalamar-358.Notes:
358 AC, apprentice of the Tower

A Silvanesti cast out for wearing the black robes, apprentice in the Tower of Palanthas, playing a careful double game.
dalamar-358.dark-elf: Cast out by the Silvanesti for practising black magic, he serves Raistlin and spies on him for the Conclave.

takhisis-avatar.Notes:
The Queen of Darkness, at the gate of the Abyss

The Queen of Darkness in the shape of a five-headed dragon. She can't be killed, only driven back.
takhisis-avatar.five-breaths:
Frequency once per 1d4 rounds
One of her five heads breathes, a 60-foot cone or a 120-foot line: @Damage[25d6[fire]] (red), electricity (blue), poison (green), acid (black) or cold (white), @Check[reflex|dc:44|basic].
takhisis-avatar.dark-majesty: 120 feet. Creatures that enter attempt @Check[will|dc:44]; on a failure, frightened 3.

mina.Notes:
421 AC, the War of Souls

A girl with amber eyes who walked out of a storm preaching the One God, and led the Knights of Neraka to victory after victory.
mina.one-god:
Frequency three times per day
A creature she touches regains @Damage[6d8+24[healing]] Hit Points, and is freed of one condition.
mina.devotion: Mina is immune to fear, and soldiers who follow her gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves.

palin-majere.Notes:
Age of Mortals

Caramon's son, a mage who lost the moons with everyone else and learned the wild magic of the world to keep going.
palin-majere.wild-sorcery: Magic of the world, without the moons: a 20-foot burst within 120 feet, @Damage[10d6[fire]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic].
